q1_issues.issue: "left silken threads on the lantern" neither creates, destroys, consumes nor physically changes the threads, so the direct object should be Theme, not Patient.
The per-member leave rule repeats the same Patient mis-slot and gives every moth the whole shared group sk_thread_1, claiming each individual moth left all the threads.

q2_gaps: approximate / hedged exact counts ("about thirty-five silken threads") — Cardinality is specified as a native integer, and CardinalityPhrase covers only number-less vague phrases ("several", "dozens"), so a hedged numeral has no licensed form

a maintenance resultative whose result is a progressive activity rather than an adjectival state ("kept the lantern burning steadily") — the State-result shape's flat half then types the object into a verb class, (Member sk_lantern_1 burn), and whether the complement takes Ongoing beside Still is unaddressed
